latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the pdf skill, featuring a comprehensive toolkit for PDF manipulation: extract text, create, merge, split documents, and handle forms.
- Integrates access to 50+ AI models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- All functionalities accessible via a unified API endpoint with simple authentication.
- Supports direct model invocation as well as smart routing to select the best or most cost-effective model for your task.
